items.headline: Non-medical items are excluded from coverage.
items.explanation: Under Annexure I, incidental and non-medical items like laundry and specific consumables are not payable. The insurer has deducted {{flag.NON_PAYABLE.amount}} for these lines. Note that circular details for Annexure I should be confirmed.
items.fix: Collect these non-payable items from the patient as per policy terms.

items.headline: Registration charges are incorrectly treated as separate deductions.
items.explanation: Registration charges are subsumed items that should not be deducted separately under Annexure I. An amount of {{flag.SUBSUMED_ITEM.amount}} was incorrectly cut, and we can recover {{flag.SUBSUMED_ITEM.recoverable}} through an appeal. Please verify the exact circular details before submission.
items.fix: File an appeal to recover the wrongly deducted amount.

items.headline: Room rent exceeds the permitted policy limit.
items.explanation: Policy 4.2 restricts room, boarding, and nursing charges to the schedule limit. Occupying a room above this limit resulted in a deduction of {{flag.ROOM_RENT_EXCESS.amount}}.
items.fix: Move the patient to an eligible room category or take written upgrade consent.

items.headline: Proportionate deductions applied to associated medical expenses.
items.explanation: Choosing a higher room category than eligible triggers proportionate deductions on associated expenses like surgeon, OT, and nursing fees under policy 4.3 and IRDAI norms. The insurer applied a deduction of {{flag.PROP_ROOM_RENT.amount}} based on these rules.
items.fix: Move to an eligible room category or obtain the patient's written upgrade consent.

items.headline: Mandatory policy co-payment applied to the claim.
items.explanation: Policy 7.4 requires a co-payment percentage to be applied on the admissible claim amount. This standard deduction totals {{flag.COPAY.amount}} across the bill lines.
items.fix: Inform the patient about the applicable co-payment deduction.

items.headline: Proportionate deductions incorrectly applied to excluded categories.
items.explanation: Under IRDAI guidelines, proportionate deductions do not apply to ICU charges, pharmacy, diagnostics, or implants. The insurer incorrectly cut {{flag.PROP_WRONGLY_APPLIED.amount}}, and an appeal can recover {{flag.PROP_WRONGLY_APPLIED.recoverable}}.
items.fix: File an appeal to challenge the incorrect proportionate deductions.

items.headline: Investigation reports are missing from the claim submission.
items.explanation: Policy 9.2 requires all claims to be supported by complete investigation reports. The laboratory and radiology lines are flagged because these documents are currently absent.
items.fix: Attach the missing investigation reports to complete the file.

items.headline: Implant invoice and sticker are required for processing.
items.explanation: Policy 9.2 mandates submitting the implant invoice and sticker whenever an implant is used. Without this document, the implant line cannot be verified.
items.fix: Attach the missing implant invoice and sticker to the claim.
